content: Remove MP3 MetadataInstall the music-tag package:pip install music-tagThe following script removes all metadata from an MP3 file:from mutagen.mp3 import MP3mp3 = MP3("FILE_NAME.mp3")mp3.delete()mp3.save()A more complete implementation is availablehere.Battery AlertTo reduce battery wear, the charge level can be maintained approximatelybetween 20% and 85%.A Bash script checks the battery level at regular intervals and sends a notificationwhen it falls below or rises above configurable thresholds.  The battery monitoring script is availablehere.The script behavior can be configured through the following variables:  MAX_BATTERY: maximum charge threshold  MIN_BATTERY: minimum charge threshold  SLEEP_TIME: interval between checksMake the script executable:chmod u+x battery_healthTo run it after login, add the absolute script path to the desktop environment’sstartup applications.  Prefer /home/USERNAME or "$HOME" instead of ~ when configuring startupapplications or services.

title: OCaml and OPAM
snippet: Profiling OCaml PerformanceLinux perf can profile OCaml executables and collect call-graph information:            Description      Command                  Record a profile      sudo perf record -...
content: Profiling OCaml PerformanceLinux perf can profile OCaml executables and collect call-graph information:            Description      Command                  Record a profile      sudo perf record --call-graph lbr -- OCAML_EXECUTABLE              Record a profile to a named file      sudo perf record --call-graph lbr -o perf.data.old -- OCAML_EXECUTABLE              Compare two profile files      perf diff perf.data.old perf.data      A detailed guide is available inProfiling an OCaml project.OPAMMain Commands            Description      Command                  Create a global switch      opam switch create SWITCH_NAME 4.14.1              Create a local switch      opam switch create . 4.14.1              Remove a switch      opam switch remove SWITCH_NAME              Export a switch      opam switch export FILE_EXPORT.txt --switch SWITCH_NAME              Import a switch      opam switch import FILE_EXPORT.txt --switch SWITCH_NAME              Install only dependencies      opam install --deps-only PACKAGE_NAME              Pin a Git branch      opam pin add https://github.com/PATH_TO_REPO.git#BRANCH_NAME              Install a specific package version      opam install PACKAGE_NAME=VERSION      Create an Empty Switch for Coq      Create a switch:    opam switch create SWITCH_NAME 4.14.1            Select the switch and load its environment:    opam switch SWITCH_NAMEeval "$(opam env)"            Install dependencies:    opam install --deps-only coq-core coq-elpi ocamlformat            Configure the project:    ./configure              Enter /home/USER/.opam/SWITCH_NAME/bin as the executable directory.      For subsequent configuration paths, append the suggested suffix withoutreplacing the .bin directory.            Build and install:    make worlddune install coq-core coq-stdlib coqide-server      Resolve OCaml LSP ErrorsIf an OCaml project does not use Dune, Merlin may require a .merlin file:make .merlintouch dune-projectAdd the fallback option in .vscode/settings.json:{  "ocaml.server.args": [    "--fallback-read-dot-merlin"  ]}Resolve a Vnorm Error in Coq-Elpigit clean -dfxUse this command carefully: it permanently removes untracked and ignored files.Exported OPAM SwitchA reference switch configuration is availablehere.Useful Links  OPAM documentation

title: Linux
snippet: Useful Commands            Description      Command                  Restart GNOME Shell      Alt+F2, then enter r              Force-terminate a process      kill -9 PID              Switch to vir...
content:
Useful Commands            Description      Command                  Restart GNOME Shell      Alt+F2, then enter r              Force-terminate a process      kill -9 PID              Switch to virtual console 1      Ctrl+Alt+F1              Install a Debian package      sudo dpkg -i DEB_FILE              Replace text with a regular expression      echo "input" \| sed 's/IN_REGEX/OUT_REGEX/'      MakefilesCreate a variable within a rule:rule1:  $(eval VAR := $(shell YOUR_COMMAND))  echo $(VAR)Build all .tex files and place the PDFs in pdf/:RES_DIR = pdfSOURCES = $(shell ls *.tex)OBJECTS = $(addprefix $(RES_DIR)/,$(SOURCES:%.tex=%.pdf))ci: $(OBJECTS)$(RES_DIR)/%.pdf: %.tex  pdflatex -output-directory=$(RES_DIR) $<Variables evaluated with eval are local to the target:show-year:  $(eval year := $(shell date +%Y))  echo $(year)Useful PackagesZshZsh is a shell with powerful completion and history features. Install it with:sudo apt-get install zshMake Zsh the default shell:chsh -s "$(which zsh)"If Zsh is not selected in the login environment, add the following entry to~/.profile:echo '
export SHELL="/usr/bin/zsh"' >> "$HOME/.profile"A custom Zsh configuration is availablehere.Search command history by key bindingautoload -U history-search-endzle -N history-beginning-search-backward-end history-search-endzle -N history-beginning-search-forward-end history-search-endbindkey "^[[5~" history-beginning-search-backward-endbindkey "^[[6~" history-beginning-search-forward-endTo inspect a key sequence, run cat in a terminal and press the desired keys.CopyQCopyQ keeps a searchable history of copied text and files. Install it with:sudo apt-get install copyqTo start the CopyQ server automatically at login, add the following command toyour desktop environment’s startup applications:copyq --start-serverPandocPandoc converts Markdown documents into PDF or HTML. It can use a LaTeX enginefor PDF output.To generate a standalone HTML document:pandoc --toc --number-sections --standalone --embed-resources \  input.md \  --mathjax=path/to/tex-chtml-full.js \  --include-in-header=path/to/header.html \  --lua-filter=path/to/filter.lua \  -o output.html  input.md is the Markdown source file.  tex-chtml-full.js enables MathJax support.  header.html contains HTML included in the document header.  filter.lua preprocesses the document.  --toc adds a table of contents and --number-sections numbers the headings.Other Useful Packages  OPAM manages OCaml projects and compiler switches. See the OCaml post.  python-is-python3 makes python invoke python3.  VS Code is an editor available through the code package.  Pygments provides syntax highlighting for LaTeX’s minted package.Install Common PackagesOn a new Ubuntu installation, the following commands install several frequentlyused tools and initialize OPAM:sudo apt-get updatesudo apt-get install -y \  code zsh python-is-python3 opam copyq texlive-latex-extra python3-pipwget \  "https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/releases/download/3.1.9/pandoc-3.1.9-1-amd64.deb" \  "https://dfissore.github.io/MyHelp/zip/battery_health" \  "https://dfissore.github.io/MyHelp/zip/opam_switch_coq_elpi.txt"mv battery_health "$HOME/battery_health"chmod u+x "$HOME/battery_health"python3 -m pip install pygmentssudo dpkg -i pandoc-3.1.9-1-amd64.debopam init --disable-sandboxingopam switch create default ocaml-systemThe battery script is documented in My Scripts.Locale SettingsSet the local time format:echo '
export LC_TIME="en_IE.UTF-8"' >> "$HOME/.profile"Set the local paper size:echo '
export LC_PAPER="en_GB.UTF-8"' >> "$HOME/.profile"

title: LaTeX
snippet: The following templates provide reusable starting points:  Report template  Presentation templateGraphics and Images\begin{figure}[!htb]  \centering  \begin{subfigure}[b]{0.25\textwidth}    \includ...
content: The following templates provide reusable starting points:  Report template  Presentation templateGraphics and Images\begin{figure}[!htb]  \centering  \begin{subfigure}[b]{0.25\textwidth}    \includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{image-path}    \caption{Caption 1}    \label{fig:label-1}  \end{subfigure}  \begin{subfigure}[b]{0.25\textwidth}    \includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{image-path}    \caption{Caption 2}    \label{fig:label-2}  \end{subfigure}  \caption{Global caption}  \label{fig:global-label}\end{figure}Graphs with .DOT FilesAdd TikZ support in the document preamble:\usepackage{tikz}Install dot2tex (installation guide),then convert a Graphviz .dot file into a tikzpicture.To adjust the scale of a TikZ diagram:\begin{tikzpicture}[>=latex',line join=bevel,scale=0.5]Inline Images$\begin{array}{l}  \includegraphics[height=0.5cm]{image-path}\end{array}$Columns\begin{columns}  \begin{column}{0.6\textwidth}    Left column  \end{column}  \begin{column}{0.4\textwidth}    Right column  \end{column}\end{columns}Tables\begin{tabular}{|lc|}  \hline  C11 & C12 \\  C21 & C22 \\  C31 & C32 \\  \hline\end{tabular}TablesGenerator can create LaTeX table codeinteractively.Useful commands:  \multicolumn{2}{c}{TEXT} combines multiple columns.  \multirow{2}{*}{TEXT} combines multiple rows.Add \usepackage{multirow} in the preamble.AlgorithmsAdd the following packages to the preamble:\usepackage[linesnumbered,ruled]{algorithm2e}\usepackage{mathtools}Example:\begin{algorithm}[H]  \caption{Angluin's $L^*$ algorithm}  \label{alg:l-star}  \KwIn{$\Sigma$}  \KwOut{$A$ such that $L(A)=U$}  $S \gets \{\varepsilon\}, E \gets \{\varepsilon\}, T \gets \text{new ObservationTable()}$  \While{$S$, $E$, $T$ are not complete}{    Complete $S$, $E$, $T$ using membership queries\;  }  \If{$S$, $E$, $T$ are not closed}{    BLA  }  \ElseIf{$S$, $E$, $T$ are not consistent}{    BLA  }  \Else{    \If{the teacher provides a counterexample $t$}{      Add $t$ and its prefixes to $E$\;    }    \Else{      \Return $A$\;    }  }\end{algorithm}MintedAdd the package to the preamble:\usepackage[outputdir=.aux]{minted}The optional outputdir=.aux argument directs compiled files to the .auxdirectory.  Minted requires the --shell-escape compiler option.For conference submissions that do not enable --shell-escape, compile once with:\usepackage[finalizecache]{minted}Then submit the project using:\usepackage[frozencache]{minted}This uses the generated cache without executing the Pygments highlighter.Table of ContentsUse an asterisk when a section should not appear in the table of contents:\section*{Introduction}Rotated Text\usepackage{rotating}\begin{turn}{90}  Text\end{turn}Compilation with a BibliographyTo write auxiliary files to .aux, run:pdflatex -synctex=1 -interaction=nonstopmode --shell-escape \  -output-directory=.aux document.texbiber --output_directory .aux documentWhen using Minted, remember to add:\usepackage[outputdir=.aux]{minted}BeamerReveal an element starting with the second step:\uncover<2->{YOUR-ELEMENT}Reveal enumerate or itemize entries incrementally:\begin{itemize}[<+->]  \item First item  \item Second item\end{itemize}Allow a frame to continue onto additional slides:\begin{frame}[allowframebreaks]{Title}Install a Custom TeX Live VersionThe following procedure installs a historical TeX Live release:cd /tmpwget https://ftp.math.utah.edu/pub/tex/historic/systems/texlive/20XX/tlnet-final/install-tl-unx.tar.gzzcat < install-tl-unx.tar.gz | tar xf -cd install-tl-*sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/texlivesudo chown "$USER" /usr/local/texlive./install-tl --repository ftp://tug.org/historic/systems/texlive/20XX/tlnet-finalThen add the installation’s architecture-specific binary directory to PATH:export PATH="/usr/local/texlive/20XX/bin/x86_64-linux:$PATH"Replace 20XX with the selected TeX Live release.Source: Seeking step-by-step TeX Live installation instructions

title: Git and GitHub
snippet: Useful Commands            Description      Command                  Remove untracked and ignored files      git clean -dfx              List all references      git show-ref              Add an ex...
content: Useful Commands            Description      Command                  Remove untracked and ignored files      git clean -dfx              List all references      git show-ref              Add an existing branch as a worktree      git worktree add PATH EXISTING_BRANCH              Add a new branch and worktree      git worktree add -b NEW_BRANCH_NAME PATH              Fetch all remotes      git fetch --all              List remotes      git remote              Display remote URLs      git remote -v              Rename a remote      git remote rename OLD_NAME NEW_NAME              Delete a local branch      git branch -d BRANCH_NAME              Delete a remote branch      git push --delete REMOTE BRANCH_NAME              Stash selected files      git stash push -- FILE1 FILE2              Stash changes while keeping staged files      git stash push --keep-index              Undo the last local commit while keeping changes      git reset HEAD~1              Add a remote repository      git remote add NEW_NAME REPOSITORY_URL              Rebase local commits before pulling      git pull --rebase      Git Pre-commit HooksA pre-commit hook runs local checks before Git creates a commit. If the hook exitswith a non-zero status, the commit is rejected.Create an executable .git/hooks/pre-commit file:#!/usr/bin/env bashmake test >& /dev/nullRESULT=$?if [[ ${RESULT} -ne 0 ]]then  RED='\033[0;31m'  printf "${RED}Unit tests failed. Commit rejected\n"fiexit ${RESULT}Make the hook executable:chmod u+x .git/hooks/pre-commitA hook can also execute any project-specific script:#!/usr/bin/env bash./my-script.shPlace my-script.sh in the repository root.Source: Prevent failing builds with pre-commit hooksA useful example that removes trailing whitespace can be foundhere(original source).Reset After an Interrupted Rebase  Run git reflog.  Find the entry labeled HEAD@{N}: rebase (start).      Reset to the commit immediately before the rebase:    git reset --hard HEAD@{N-1}      For example, if the reflog entry is:HEAD@{196}: rebase (start): checkout target-branchreset to the state before the rebase with:git reset --hard HEAD@{195}Squash Commits  Identify a commit before the commits that should be combined.      Start the interactive rebase:    git rebase -i COMMIT_HASH        Replace pick with s or squash for the commits to combine.      After resolving the generated commit message, update the remote branch:    git push origin BRANCH_NAME --force-with-lease        Force-pushing rewrites shared history. Prefer --force-with-lease and coordinatewith collaborators when working on shared branches.Source: How to squash Git commitsConfigure SSHssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "your-email@example.com"git config --global user.name "Your Name"git config --global user.email "your-email@example.com"cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pubCopy the public key into GitHub under Settings → SSH and GPG keys.Configure GPG Signingsudo apt-get install gnupggpg --full-generate-keygpg --list-secret-keys --keyid-format=longThe key ID appears after sec rsa4096/ in the output. Export the public key:gpg --armor --export KEY_IDCopy the output into GitHub under Settings → SSH and GPG keys, then configureGit:git config --global commit.gpgsign truegit config --global user.signingkey KEY_IDMerge a Remote Repository into the Current Branchgit remote add source https://github.com/ORGANIZATION/REPOSITORY.gitgit remote updategit switch -c target-branchgit merge --allow-unrelated-histories source/maingit push -u origin target-branchUseful Links  Git branch documentation  Git graphical interfaces  Autolinked references and URLs

title: Docker
snippet: Docker automates application deployment in lightweight containers. Containersisolate applications and their dependencies, making them easier to run consistentlyacross development and production env...
content: Docker automates application deployment in lightweight containers. Containersisolate applications and their dependencies, making them easier to run consistentlyacross development and production environments.Source: WikipediaUseful Commands  Docker commands that change system resources may require administrator privileges.            Description      Command                  Build an image      docker build -t IMAGE_NAME .              List images      docker images              Run an image with an interactive shell      docker run -it IMAGE_NAME /bin/bash              Copy a file from the host to a container      docker cp PATH_ON_HOST CONTAINER_NAME:PATH_IN_CONTAINER              Copy a file from a container to the host      docker cp CONTAINER_NAME:PATH_IN_CONTAINER PATH_ON_HOST              Remove all containers      docker rm -vf $(docker ps -aq)              Create a container without starting it      docker create --name CONTAINER_NAME IMAGE_NAME              Start a container      docker start CONTAINER_NAME      Docker images are immutable templates used to create containers. A container isa running instance of an image.  CMD provides the default command executed when a container starts.  ENTRYPOINT defines the executable that receives arguments passed to docker run.Docker InstallationThe following procedure installs Docker Engine on Ubuntu.# Remove potentially conflicting packagesfor pkg in docker.io docker-doc docker-compose docker-compose-v2 \  podman-docker containerd runc; do sudo apt-get remove $pkg; done# Install prerequisitessudo apt-get updatesudo apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl# Add Docker's official GPG keysudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyringssudo curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg \  -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.ascsudo chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc# Add the repository to Apt sources:echo \  "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu \  $(. /etc/os-release && echo "$VERSION_CODENAME") stable" | \  sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list > /dev/nullsudo apt-get update# Install Docker Enginesudo apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io \  docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin# Verify the installationsudo docker run --rm hello-worldSource: Install Docker Engine on UbuntuDockerfile ExampleThis example installs a complete TeX Live distribution in an Ubuntu-based image:FROM ubuntu:xenialENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND noninteractiveRUN apt-get update -q && apt-get install -qy \    texlive-full \    python-pygments gnuplot \    make git \    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*WORKDIR /dataVOLUME ["/data"]
